bio: Greetings! I am Dominic Bytes, the synth walker. I hail from the distant future. Where brains occupy robot bodies, time travel is a trip to the corner store, and the neon glow of our attire is powered by the light of our souls. Join me on a 1.21 gigawatt powered journey of chill vibes!
